title: CR-B full-census manifest schema registry
description: Declares the schema identifiers every CR-B full-census manifest artifact carries in its 'schema' member. Each identifier names a frozen, verify-side-enforced contract; the enforcing verifier is named per identifier. All digests are lowercase sha256 hex; all JSONL lines are canonical engine_b JSON terminated by a single newline; every sealed object carries its own digest field computed over the canonical bytes with that field removed.

ORION.NQ.EngineB.FullCensusDeclaredPlan..contents: both declared census scopes, their frozen denominators (98622 and 230983), and the contiguous ordinal partitions (25 and 57) with record_count, sealed by plan_sha256

ORION.NQ.EngineB.MatrixActionManifest.v1.artifact: regenerated in-memory and digest-bound into every candidate record
ORION.NQ.EngineB.MatrixActionManifest.v1.contents: the complete GL(3,5) matrix-action enumeration: 1488000 matrices, 9 bytes payload per matrix, sealed by matrix_sha256

ORION.NQ.EngineB.CensusCandidate.v1.contents: one canonical JSONL line per census record carrying ordinal, sequence, matrix_witness_sha256, orbit_key_sha256, derivation_sha256, sealed by candidate_sha256; outcome-free by construction

ORION.NQ.EngineB.MaterializedScope.v1.contents: the frozen shard layout of one scope: shard paths relative to the scope root, byte counts, payload digests, first and last record ids, ordinal coverage of the whole scope

ORION.NQ.EngineB.FullCensusDeclarationRe.contents: the input-identity declaration binding origin_main_commit, stack_parent_commit, source_manifest_sha256 and plan_sha256 with zero execution authority and lunarc_submission NOT_SUBMITTED at seal time

ORION.NQ.EngineB.ExternalDRUPBatchReceip.contents: per-scope external DRUP batch outcome: pinned protocol and checker tree identity, per-line receipts, counts, and the all-UNSAT-verified terminal

independence_clause: No schema in this registry admits an Engine-A module, canonicalized candidate list, forbidden set, orbit manifest, or aggregate result as an input; frozen denominators enter only as fail-closed expected counts.
